scope: Seven real GPU cases across the six previously unfilled categories; small public/owned fixture set, not general release certification.

runs.name: person
runs.instruction: Replace only the background with a plain neutral grey studio backdrop. Keep the person, face, hair, orange suit, patches and helmet exactly unchanged. No extra people or objects.
runs.visualReview: SCOPED PASS: neutral backdrop; 140114 protected subject pixels exact. Edge refinement may still be needed.
runs.scope: One fixture only; general photographic fidelity is not certified

runs.name: garment
runs.instruction: Change only the selected orange sleeve fabric to dark navy blue. Preserve the existing folds, stitching, shading and sleeve shape. Keep all unselected parts, face and patches unchanged.
runs.visualReview: FAIL: manual polygon creates an obvious partial sleeve patch. Superseded by SAM selection and recolour boundary correction.
runs.scope: One fixture only; general photographic fidelity is not certified
runs.compositor: No old-colour matching or inward fade for Recolour

runs.name: environment
runs.instruction: Extend only the sky upward, continuing its existing dark blue colour and atmosphere. Add no objects, stars, text or rockets. Preserve all original launch imagery exactly.
runs.visualReview: SCOPED PASS: coherent upward sky extension; 175104 original pixels exact.
runs.scope: One fixture only; general photographic fidelity is not certified

runs.name: sketch
runs.instruction: Turn this simple chair sketch into a clean studio photograph of one blue wooden chair. Keep the chair's rectangular back, flat seat and four legs in the same three-quarter view and position. Plain white background. No text or extra objects.
runs.visualReview: SCOPED PASS: one blue chair follows the source structure and view. Whole-image interpretation has no pixel-exact guarantee.
